say:1:1330115001:0.text: Well... I was supposed to convince Faylin to come with me.
say:1:1330115001:0.source_cn: 这可不是重点……重点在于说服她和我一起去。
say:1:1330115001:0.male: Well... I was supposed to convince Faylin to come with me.
say:1:1330115001:0.female: Well... I was supposed to convince Faylin to come with me.

say:2:1330115002:0.text: If I were to do that, I'd need to come up with ample reasons.
say:2:1330115002:0.source_cn: 如果在去祭典前叫她，那首先得准备足够的理由说服她。
say:2:1330115002:0.male: If I were to do that, I'd need to come up with ample reasons.
say:2:1330115002:0.female: If I were to do that, I'd need to come up with ample reasons.

say:3:1330115003:0.text: The festival might have already ended by the time I got her to say yes.
say:3:1330115003:0.source_cn: 那样的话，可能直到祭典结束，我也别想出发。
say:3:1330115003:0.male: The festival might have already ended by the time I got her to say yes.
say:3:1330115003:0.female: The festival might have already ended by the time I got her to say yes.
